text_block_list.text: It's finally time for the spring Tenno Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро МакКуин nervously thinks of her
family as
she vows to give the race
everything she has.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Just before she goes onto the track, she
comes
face-to-face with Мэдзиро Райан.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The two declare to give the race their all
as
members of the Mejiro family.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
